items.title: Ukraine air raid app apparently hacked as users receive false radiation threat, Air Force says
items.summary: Authorities say there is no threat and have advised the public to stay calm and follow official channels for information.

items.title: Five teenagers stabbed at Halloween party
items.summary: Hampshire Police believes an unknown group gained entry to the party at an address in Chandler's Ford.

items.title: Thousands of jobs at Virgin Media O2 to be cut
items.summary: The broadband provider has not finalised the number of roles to be axed but it will likely be a sizeable chunk of its workforce, the BBC understands.

items.title: Nowak family tell of 'unbelievable pain' of seeing footage of dying son handcuffed
items.summary: His family describe the night police told them of his death, and watching him being handcuffed.

items.title: King to address slavery in Antigua as PM says he is open to possible UK apology
items.summary: King Charles III will deliver a speech to the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting on Tuesday as he concludes his nine-day Caribbean tour.

items.title: Antonelli becomes world champion as Verstappen wins in Mexico
items.summary: Kimi Antonelli becomes the youngest world champion in Formula 1 history as Max Verstappen wins the Mexico City Grand Prix.

items.title: Tributes to 'inspirational' Olympian Ciara Mageean after death at 34
items.summary: The former European 1500m champion had bowel cancer and died just three weeks after marrying her partner.

items.title: Democrat endorses Republican candidate in key Michigan Senate race as party spat erupts
items.summary: Haley Stevens, who lost out on the Democratic Senate nomination to Abdul El-Sayed, endorses his opponent days before the vote.
